Android uses a low-priority notification while ST is running so the local service remains visible. Denying notification permission does not prevent ST from starting, but the notification may not appear in the drawer.
STM Core 0.1 provides an isolated Android Node.js host through its internal Feather Engine.
Activate a runnable version in ST management, then start STM Core from the dashboard. This page loads only a real ST loopback URL reported ready by Core.
Navigation outside the current STM Core loopback session was blocked.

Download, update, switch, and manage your SillyTavern versions. Core jobs, internal slots, and verification evidence live in Logs.

Android’s system downloader first resolves the selected branch to an exact commit, then saves the commit-pinned ZIP in STM’s external app-specific download cache. You can install it with Core or run preflight only.
Preview is not recommended. No signed runtime layer is published for Preview, so installation requires an on-device build that typically takes about 10 minutes.
Resolving the branch to an exact commit
No ST archives have been downloaded.
Unverified; the cache file location does not prove a repository.
No exact commit is known; STM will not infer one from the file name.
No completion-time SHA-256 record is available.
PK header present; this is not full ZIP validation.
PK header missing; archive format is unidentified.

Downloaded archives remain external cache entries until you choose Install. Stable uses a signed runtime layer published by STM. Preview has no prebuilt runtime layer and requires your explicit confirmation for an on-device build of about 10 minutes. A READY slot is committed only after runnable acceptance. Deleting cache does not delete Core slots or user data.

Core first tries a signed runtime layer that exactly matches this ST version. It never starts the slower bundled npm construction without your explicit confirmation. Both paths run staged acceptance before atomically committing the READY slot.
Preview is not recommended and never attempts signed fast installation. Starting its approximately 10-minute on-device build still requires another explicit confirmation.
STM could not download the signed runtime layer. Check the active network, DNS, proxy, or VPN, then retry. You can also explicitly choose slower local construction.
STM does not currently provide a signed runtime layer for this exact SillyTavern version. You can stop here or explicitly build the runtime locally.

Local construction downloads and processes many npm files. It typically takes about 10 minutes and uses substantially more storage, memory, and battery. Keep the network stable and do not force-stop STM.

STM will use its bundled npm 11.6.2 toolchain to install dependencies and build lib.js on this device, which typically takes about 10 minutes. If you continue, keep the network stable and do not force-stop STM.

STM will use its bundled npm 11.6.2 toolchain to install dependencies and build lib.js on this device, which typically takes about 10 minutes. Preview is not recommended for ordinary users. If you continue, keep the network stable and do not force-stop STM.
Preflight only re-hashes, safely extracts and inspects the exact source. It does not install dependencies or create a READY slot.
This channel is already downloaded. Delete the old archive before downloading it again.
Android’s system download service is unavailable.
STM could not obtain this channel’s current exact commit from GitHub. Check the active network, DNS, proxy, or VPN and try again.
The system downloader could not complete this download.
The new download did not contain the expected ZIP format hint or its reported length changed, so STM removed that download.
STM could not access its app-specific download directory.
Only user-manageable SillyTavern versions appear here. Test fixtures and Core technical fields stay out of this screen.
No manageable SillyTavern version is installed.
STM Core is stopped and can accept one maintenance request.
A Core maintenance job is active; slot actions remain disabled until it finishes.
Slot maintenance requires STM Core and its internal Feather Engine session to be stopped.
Active and frozen by the running session
Remove slot “%1$s” from STM Core? Active and running slots are protected, and Core user data is not removed.
STM Core will try to restore the previously committed active pointer. If no previous pointer is available, Core will record a failed maintenance job.
This READY evidence belongs to a synthetic Gate 2 acceptance fixture. It is not a real SillyTavern installation and cannot make ST runnable.
This is SillyTavern source identity only. Dependency assembly and runnable acceptance remain Stage 3 requirements.
STM Core has not published bounded artifact identity evidence for this slot.
Length and SHA-256 recorded; no signed catalog comparison
Length and SHA-256 reverified by Core
STM Core reports no maintenance-job history.
Installing production dependencies (may take several minutes)
Building local lib.js bundle (may take several minutes)

The first 5-minute interval has elapsed. The network, npm registry, device storage, or many small-file writes may be slow. Continue waiting for another 5 minutes, or cancel and clean the staging operation.
The 2-minute interval has elapsed. The device may be busy or low on available memory. Continue waiting for another 2 minutes, or cancel the local build.
The 20-second interval has elapsed. ST configuration, plugins, or a busy device may be delaying its local health check. Continue waiting for another 20 seconds, or cancel installation.
The 15-second interval has elapsed. ST configuration, plugins, or a busy device may be delaying startup. Continue waiting for another 15 seconds, or stop ST.
Inspect Core state, maintenance jobs, internal slot evidence, and STM app events. These records are never presented as installed ST versions.

Save a bounded text report containing device, WebView, Core, slot, job, STM event, and recent SillyTavern Node log details. It may contain local paths and technical information; review it before sharing.
The report could not be exported. An error event was added below.
Diagnostic details follow, including test fixtures, internal identifiers, manifests, and integrity evidence.
STM Core has no slot records.
Core maintenance jobs appear above. This section records events emitted by the STM management shell.
Adjust appearance and language, or manage STM’s own files.
Browse, edit text files, and delete files stored in STM’s private data areas.
Uninstall STM and delete all app data
This is separate from removing an ST version or clearing download cache. Android will delete STM, every Core slot, cache, settings, and ST user data only after its own uninstall confirmation.
STM will open Android’s app details. Review the warning there and choose Uninstall only if you intend to permanently delete STM and all of its app data. This cannot be undone from STM.
Browse the internal and external data directories that belong to this app.
Changes take effect immediately. Editing or deleting internal files can reset settings, interrupt downloads, or make STM unusable. The app data roots themselves cannot be deleted.
Delete “%1$s” and everything inside it? This cannot be undone.
This app data area is not available.
